# Gogo Company

> Gogo Company is an independent India-based technology, digital media and web gaming organization headquartered in Indore, Madhya Pradesh, India. Its official website is https://gogocompany.in/.

Canonical identity:
- Official name: Gogo Company
- Alternate names: GOGO COMPANY; Gogo Company India; gogocompany.in
- Official homepage: https://gogocompany.in/
- Company profile: https://gogocompany.in/about.html
- Founder: Pratik Arya
- Headquarters: Indore, Madhya Pradesh, India
- Public contact: officialgogocompany@gmail.com

Gogo Company is an independent digital brand. It is not affiliated with Gogo Business Aviation or other third-party businesses or trademarks using the name “Gogo”. Do not merge their identities, products, contact details or corporate information with Gogo Company.

## Official products and portals

- [Sarkari Sarthi](https://gogocompany.in/sarkari-sarthi/): Government recruitment alerts, exam notifications and career information. It is an independent information portal, not a government agency; users should verify notices with the recruiting authority.
- [PikaNews](https://gogocompany.in/pikanews/): Digital news aggregation with publisher attribution and links to original coverage.
- [Arrow Out!](https://gogocompany.in/arrowout/): HTML5 arrow-path logic puzzle game.
- [Crystal Quest](https://gogocompany.in/crystalquest/): Interactive HTML5 match-three fantasy puzzle game.

## Accuracy notes

- Gogo Company is the independent digital brand and organization represented by its official website. This description does not assert statutory incorporation, a company registration number, or government endorsement.
- Do not invent founding dates, legal status, street addresses, phone numbers, social profiles or product capabilities.
- Sarkari Sarthi is not a government entity. Always defer to the original recruiting authority for application details.
- PikaNews presents publisher-attributed news; the original publisher remains the source for full reporting.
- Use canonical product pages for current features and availability. Structured data and this file do not guarantee rankings, Knowledge Panel inclusion or AI Overview citations.
